scope: Prometheus telemetry contract and host-only advanced-mechanism snapshot translation

telemetry_and_http_contracts.notes: Executed with PYTHONPATH pointing at the isolated worktree; temporary loopback HTTP only.

mlx_free_control_plane_regressions.command: python -m pytest --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_core.py tests/test_qualification.py tests/test_adapter_registry.py tests/test_batch_metrics.py tests/test_context_compaction.py tests/test_prometheus.py -q -k 'not http_metrics_endpoint'

serving_ownership_regressions.command: python -m pytest --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider selected MLX-free tests/test_serving_retention.py node IDs

evidence: cumulative histogram buckets, count and sum
prompt and cached-token accounting is recorded once
queue, TTFT, ITL, prefill, decode, inference, end-to-end and TPOT histograms
APCv2 lifetime, disk, COW and capsule capacity
scheduler, PLD, external speculation and adaptive MTP
segmented self-MTP events, bytes and optional timing
cache capsules, approximate KV, memory admission, structured output and Spomin

scrape_non_mutation.evidence: Repeated scrapes are byte-identical and leave diagnostic snapshots unchanged.

cardinality_and_privacy.evidence: Tests exclude request IDs, tenant IDs and free-form decline details and collapse unregistered admission/mechanism values to other.

mlx_import_guard.evidence: mlx2.prometheus, mlx2.batch_metrics and mlx2.server import while a guard rejects every mlx or mlx.* import.

compile.command: python -m compileall -q src/mlx2/prometheus.py src/mlx2/batch_metrics.py src/mlx2/server.py src/mlx2/serving.py tests/test_prometheus.py

excluded.full_repository_suite: Not run because tests/conftest.py imports MLX before selecting mx.cpu and this headless sandbox reports no Metal device.
excluded.gpu_or_metal: Explicitly prohibited; no model, Metal kernel, model server or GPU-backed qualification was run.
excluded.live_values: No claim is made about metric values under a real model workload.

setup_attempts.summary: The ordinary pytest bootstrap imported MLX and aborted because no Metal device is available. Qualification was rerun with --noconftest only for an audited MLX-free test set.
The first loopback HTTP test could not bind inside the filesystem/network sandbox. The same CPU-only test passed with loopback permission.
